newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in livelier trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in livelier trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in livelier trade on Thursday.
* Seven of 17 active stocks rose, seven fell and three remained flat.
* Volume was higher at 11,776 shares, while turnover almost doubled to 6.4 million kuna.
* Biggest loser, hotelier Riviera fell 11 kuna to 130, trading 400 shares.
* Top gainer, hotelier Jadranturist added 10 kuna to 250, on volume of 1,031 shares.
* The most active issue, food concern Podravka sold 2,773 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
